title: Auto & Tractor Parts Workshop in Pakistan: Real Cost
description:
Small workshops make many of the brackets, bolts and bushes in Pakistani cars, bikes and tractors. We explain what such a workshop makes, how an order becomes a part, the machines and full cost from a Government of Pakistan (SMEDA) study, the team, and what to watch out for.
